outcome: Maternal complications (age at diagnosis, parity, antepartum complications, overt diabetes)
cohort: The study included 90 patients diagnosed with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus.
finding: Gestational diabetes mellitus was associated with significant feto-maternal morbidity, including a high caesarean section rate, increased neonatal complications, and a substantial proportion of patients developing overt diabetes within one year.
mod_finding: The caesarean section rate was high (74%) in the diabetic group.
